Messages.Author: Ralf Lammert
Messages.Body:
Some question about "Change of Target":

When a vampire must hunt (because he is on zero blood),
and you play Change of Target, what can the vampire do ?

a. Must the vampire hunt again ?
b. Can the vampire do want he wants to do, except hunting?
c. Is the vampire doomed to do nothing ?
d. Or aren`t you allowed to play the CoT ?

Bye
Ralf

Messages.Author: L. Scott Johnson
Messages.Body:


C. The vampire must hunt (zero blood) and cannot (Change of Target),
so he's stuck and cannot take any action.

--
L. Scott Johnson (vte...@regency.wizards.com)
Official VtES Net.Rep for Wizards of the Coast.
(*) - Subject to review by Rules Team

Okay, I guess the question is this:

Can "Change of Target" be played in reaction to an attempt to block my
Vampire from hunting if he has 0 blood?

By the text on the card I would assume it's okay seeing as there was an
attempt to block. Both minions should untap; however by card text that
minion may not take the same action again. I believe by game definition
that if a Vampire has 0 blood that "Hunting" is the only action that
minion has available to him, correct?
That being the case, having played "Change of Target" I would think that
the minion would not be able to take any further actions (still being
hungry and all that).

Do you see where I'm going with this?
